items.title: Silver Warriors (Ages 55+) | Seniors Group
items.desc: We seek to provide opportunities to learn from one another, to serve one another, to encourage one another, and to pray for one another. There is no set format but we will allow the Holy Spirit to guide and direct us each week. The primary meeting will be every Tuesday, but we expect to see smaller groups choose to meet over a meal, take an easy hike, or undertake a service project at different times and places.

items.title: Broadmoor Waltz Lessons | Co-Ed Activity Group
items.desc: Looking to brush up your dancing skills? In sixteen weeks, learn how to pattern waltz for fun and for free. Couples will learn twelve choreographed waltz dances used by The Broadmoor Waltz Club.

items.title: Friday Prayer | Men's Group
items.desc:
"Iron Sharpens Iron" (Proverbs 27:17)

An informal fellowship of men committed to prayer for each other, our families, the Lord's church, and our nation. We develop friendships and encourage one another to know and serve Jesus, unified in our belief that God hears and answers prayer.

On-line participation is available for those who are not able to join us in person.

items.title: Springs Men | Breakfast Gathering
items.desc:
Our monthly Springs Men Breakfast gathering takes place the 1st Saturday of every month at 8AM in the Kids Auditorium. We gather around tables for food and fellowship. This is a great opportunity to meet new friends. We typically hear from a speaker and then follow up with conversation. Bring your son, brother or neighbor. We hope to see you there!

We ask for a $10 donation to help cover the cost of food for you and someone else who may not be able to afford it. You also have the option of paying in cash on Saturday. Park in the back lot and enter through the ramp to the Kids Auditorium. Look for the signs.

items.title: Springs Women | Christmas Tea
items.desc:
The annual Springs Women Christmas Tea takes place Saturday, December 5, from 1-3PM in the Main Lobby and Sanctuary. Come enjoy an afternoon of tea and fellowship with the women of Springs as we celebrate the Christmas season together.

Seats are $25 each, and you'll pick the table you'd like to join when you register. Childcare is available for this event. Please register yourself and/or your child by Tuesday, December 1, when registration closes.
